title: Require Service Router Authorship
forbids: a detached function declaration beside a router handler; operation logic, non-router runtime imports, default imports, namespace imports, or side-effect imports in module router.ts; or an explicitly extracted multi-operation group without its purpose, shared capability or guard, behavior, and neighboring relation
why: Named router handlers are the operation authoring sites. Keeping transitions in router/*.router.ts, module router.ts limited to named local router values and plain composition, and explicitly extracted semantic groups documented prevents a second hand-built execution layer.
remediate: Author complete handlers in named router/*.router.ts files. Move independent decisions to model policy, subordinate stateless mechanics to model helpers, and outside calls behind context-provided ports. Keep module/router.ts to type-only imports, named runtime imports from ./router/<name>.router, and the composed router export. Standalone leaves and flat router objects need no group comment; document each extracted multi-operation subset composed into a router with @purpose, @capability, @behavior, and @relation.
message: Service router files must retain operation authorship and compose without displaced logic.
